comparison.objective: Depress an Ethernet latch and unplug a cable from a modem; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Small latch depression coordinated with axial plug extraction, not screw/nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Plug must be fully removed without prohibited equipment displacement or damage; candidate requires retained angle and functional cycling.
comparison.reason: Latch-release extraction is distinct from coupled threaded adjustment in both versions.
